duration.text: The Applied Chemistry at Guangxi Normal University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK level 3 or above Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Undergraduate school transcript Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: Bachelor's degree or its equivalent Basic Chinese knowledge with HSK level 3 or above Be in good health
